private.publication_generated_report:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.publication_generated_report(j jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare v jsonb;begin
 if jsonb_typeof(j)='object' then select coalesce(jsonb_object_agg(k,private.publication_generated_report(x)),'{}') into v from jsonb_each(j) t(k,x) where k not in('quote','quote_sha256');return v;
 elsif jsonb_typeof(j)='array' then select coalesce(jsonb_agg(private.publication_generated_report(x) order by n),'[]') into v from jsonb_array_elements(j) with ordinality t(x,n);return v;end if;return j;
end $function$
private.recommendation_spend_context_v1:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.recommendation_spend_context_v1(raw jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select coalesce((select jsonb_build_object('price_per_person',min(v),'price_per_person_source_key',min(k)) from (
  select key k,btrim(value#>>'{}') v from jsonb_each(case when jsonb_typeof(raw)='object' then raw else '{}' end)
  where private.recommendation_key_v1(key) in('price per person','prix par personne','gia moi nguoi')
   and jsonb_typeof(value)='string' and btrim(value#>>'{}')<>''
 ) q having count(distinct v)=1),'{}'::jsonb)
$function$
